name: Oreo Pie
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ gallon (1.9 L) ice cream (usually vanilla)
3 crumb crusts (preferably Graham cracker or chocolate)

steps: Begin by softening the ice cream enough to spread.
Mix the softened ice cream with the Cool Whip.
Crumble the Oreos. This can be done by putting the Oreos into a plastic bag and crushing them with a rolling pin.
Mix the Oreos into the ice cream mixture.
Spread the mixture evenly into the 3 pie crusts.
